verdicts.reason: Both lose the original's full-bleed pizza background. The photo shrinks to a small, washed-out thumbnail sitting loose on white, with no link to the orange headline band, and the headline wraps into choppy lines with 'to' orphaned on its own line. A pushes the band near the top and leaves about 200px of empty white at the bottom, so it is badly lopsided; B is the same layout but centred vertically, so its empty space is more evenly spread, which makes it marginally less unbalanced.
